Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. If you cannot quote the code that proves a finding, do not report it.

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 73 = LAW L-ab SPOTLIGHT, the render side (orchestrator 2026-11-13 '22:41' ruling 90 and '22:53' rulings 91 / 92, verbatim excerpts): "A SECOND PIN KIND, 'spotlight' ... ONE moment, one speaker, one channel: 12 to 35 s of clip. No hook/clip split, no bridge, no join. Then at most ONE closing line ... 12 words or fewer ... Then the sign-off and the credits card with that one channel, then the outro. Total 28 to 50 s. Both formats. ... EVERY integrity law is unchanged ... Only the taste rules that assume a medley change for this kind. YOUR SIDE, the render for kind 'spotlight' (moments pins only; medley and story paths unchanged, the protected references must reproduce): edl_rules for this kind: R4 runtime 28-50 s, no hook/clips minimum, R11 VO_SHAPE = 0 bridges and 0 or 1 closing line; G5 duration 28-50 s; G14 coverage on one clip; the credits card and the sign-off VO with ONE channel ...; every other gate as is. The publishing kit carries the builder's first-comment draft verbatim. Delivery: the pass path when every release gate passes, labelled as a SPOTLIGHT candidate for PBX's approval ... the first is a demonstration" and 91: "Default for a spotlight: NO PBX line; the clip goes straight to the sign-off ... A line ... is kept only if a separate VALUE verdict ... answers all of ... ; anything short of a clear yes means no line."
The contract agreed with the builder: moments_package.type 'moments' + shape 'spotlight'; exactly ONE segment, role hook; edl_vo {intro: null, bridges: [], closing: null or ONE line <= 12 words}; a closing line only with sealed rows closing_value, closing_fidelity, closing_context exactly PASS and not replayed; required rows spotlight_source, hook_own, stands_alone, step_a_two_families, visual, window_12h, never_delivered, one_per_channel_day, precheck; first_comment = the builder's WHOLE first comment (credits included), printed verbatim, nothing appended.
Facts the change relies on (mapped and checked): with edl["clips"] == [] the renderers place only the intro slot (hook -> intro VO -> shout-out with the sign-off -> outro); a bridge keyed to a clip would be rendered and silently dropped, so the closing line is mapped to vo.intro. G5 lives in segment_v1/qa_gates.py and run_all_gates already receives edl_path (gates.run_gates passes <run>/edl.json).
The change: pinned.py (SPOTLIGHT constants, is_spotlight, validate_schema's one-segment rule, _spotlight_vo called from moments_vo, build_edl writes package_shape and first_comment); edl_rules.py (_spotlight; R4's window 28-50 and a 12-word cap on the intro slot; R5 -> _r5_spotlight: no clips, the moment measured and with a channel, 12-35 s a taste deviation; R11 spotlight branch); qa_gates.py (G5_SPOTLIGHT_S, g5_window(edl_path), gate_g5(window=)); editorial_gate.py (LAW 1 and LAW 4, the medley laws, pass for a spotlight; L0 / LAW 2 / LAW 3 still bind); signoff.py (one-channel registers; the medley prompt byte-identical); vo.py (singular fallback for one channel); telegram.py (SPOTLIGHT_HEAD on the pass-path caption, first_comment verbatim, the spotlight's deviation windows). Tests: test_pinned.TestSpotlight (9 refusals), test_edl_rules.TestSpotlightRules, test_spotlight.py (G5 on a real 34 s file, editorial gate, kit, caption, sign-off registers, card layout); 345 related tests pass but 5 that are environmental or pre-existing on main.
FIND: a medley or story path whose behaviour changes (any rule, gate, prompt or kit text); a path where a spotlight passes with two segments, a clip, a bridge, a closing line without its three rows or over 12 words, a missing required row, or a non-moments type; a gate or rule that now passes a spotlight because nothing was measured (fail open); G5 taking the spotlight window for a non-spotlight EDL. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.
